item.tib: sngags kyi mdo 'dur rin chen phreng ba mu tsho'i khrom 'dur chen mo las tshe 'das rigs drug gi gnas nas drangs thabs
item.coloph: gshen 'chi med gtsug phud kyis gsungs so/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i (pas) 'gro ba mtho ris su drangs so/ gnas mchog 'di ni gshin pa kha dod tsam drangs pa'i don du mdzad pa'o//
